notes.title: Christmas Update 2023!
notes.content:
- Added Christmas decorations around the store!
- Added a new Christmas Easter egg to the game. (Keep an eye on YouTube for how to do it)
- Added a Christmas Shopping achievement for completing the Easter Egg!
- Fixed some bugs
